description: Altera Agilex 5 E-Series FPGAs and SoC FPGAs. Format: A5E{hps}{density}{group}{package}{grade}{speed}{power}[suffix]. Examples: A5ED065BB32AE4SR0 (SoC, 065B, B32A, Extended speed 4, Standard power, R0 dev-kit suffix); A5ED065AB32AI2V (SoC, 065A, B32A, Industrial speed 2, SmartVID power).

fields.label: Device Code
fields.description: Combined HPS / transceiver / crypto code per the Agilex 5 Device Overview (doc 762191) ordering-code legend (Figure 4). Encodes the hard processor system, transceiver availability and crypto services.

options.label: B (SoC)
options.description: SoC with Quad HPS (dual-core Arm Cortex-A55 + dual-core Arm Cortex-A76), no transceivers.

options.label: D (SoC)
options.description: SoC with Quad HPS (dual-core Arm Cortex-A55 + dual-core Arm Cortex-A76), with transceivers.

options.label: E (SoC)
options.description: SoC with Dual HPS (dual-core Arm Cortex-A55), no transceivers.

options.label: G (FPGA)
options.description: FPGA with crypto services, no HPS, no transceivers (B18A package only).

fields.label: Logic Density
fields.description: Three-digit density code (approximate LE count in thousands).

fields.label: Device Group
fields.description: Device group letter — distinguishes resource tiers within the density.

fields.label: Package
fields.description: Package type and body size. B = VPBGA (Variable Pitch BGA); M = MBGA (Micro FineLine BGA).

options.label: B15A
options.description: 15 mm x 15 mm VPBGA, variable pitch.

options.label: M16A
options.description: 16 mm x 16 mm MBGA, 0.5 mm pitch.

options.label: B18A
options.description: 18 mm x 18 mm VPBGA, variable pitch.

options.label: B23A
options.description: 23 mm x 23 mm VPBGA (variant A), variable pitch.

options.label: B23B
options.description: 23 mm x 23 mm VPBGA (variant B), variable pitch.

options.label: B32A
options.description: 32 mm x 32 mm VPBGA, variable pitch.

fields.label: Speed Grade
fields.description: Core fabric speed grade. Lower = faster. E-Series spans 1 (fastest) to 6 per the Agilex 5 Device Overview (doc 762191) ordering-code legend.

fields.label: Power Option
fields.description: Power option. Per the Agilex 5 Device Overview (doc 762191): S = Standard Power (fixed voltage), V = Standard Power (SmartVID), E = Lower Power (SmartVID), X = Lowest Voltage (fixed voltage). SmartVID (V/E) applies to D-Series and E-Series Device Group A.

options.label: V (SmartVID)
options.description: Standard power, SmartVID — core voltage set via a PMBus regulator to the device's VID code.
